The '''Daimar system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] that was located within the [[Daimar sector/Legends|Daimar sector]], in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="Atlas Companion" /> It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Daimar]], which was [[Blockade of Daimar|blockaded]] by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] shortly after the end of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="FOR" />
